Target: NVIDIA (NVDA). NVIDIA designs accelerated computing platforms, GPUs and related software used in data centers, AI, graphics and gaming.

Focal announcement: National Institute of Standards and Technology Launches Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute Consortium.

Decision cutoff: 2024-02-08T23:59:59-05:00. Only information available before this cutoff is admissible.

Source: National Institute of Standards and Technology Launches Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute Consortium. Published: 2024-02-08. URL: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/aisic-trustworthy-ai.

Condensed source facts; other details are omitted: NVIDIA has joined the National Institute of Standards and Technology’s new U.S. Artificial Intelligence Safety Institute Consortium as part of the company’s effort to advance safe, secure and trustworthy AI . AISIC will work to create tools, methodologies and standards to promote the safe and trustworthy development and deployment of AI. As a member, NVIDIA will work with NIST — an agency of the U.S. Department of Commerce — and fellow consortium members to advance the consortium’s mandate. Last month, the company announced a $30 million contribution to the U.S. National Science Foundation’s National Artificial Intelligence Research Resource pilot program , which aims to broaden access to the tools needed to power responsible AI discovery and innovation. These are coarse descriptions computed from observed historical inputs. Strong past movement or relative strength is not evidence that the next return must continue or reverse.

The previously fitted market-only reference model had no clear preference but ranked an upward return beyond the neutral band first. Its leading outcome was uncertain, with no clear preference. It still assigned meaningful possibility to a return inside the narrow neutral band and a downward return beyond the neutral band. This is a training-only model forecast, not an observed outcome or independent news evidence.

The neutral return band's half-width is much narrower than the code-computed ordinary five-session variability scale. An irrelevant article does not eliminate ordinary price movement; this is not a calculated class probability.

Forecast target: entry is the first regular-session open after the cutoff; exit is the fifth session close, counting entry as session one. Raw return above +1% is up; within inclusive -1% to +1% is flat; below -1% is down. The initial pre-entry reaction is outside this target.

Do not invent analyst consensus, incremental target sales, new corporate cash payments, or an already-priced news reaction.
